baseline.$comment: RFC-0018 CO-4: the rung's serving record served at the ladder's concurrencies; full load is the lowest concurrency within the plateau of the highest rate. Null fields and a cause when no baseline run is stored or none of its ladder rungs succeeded.

check.$comment: RFC-0018 §The six checks: an undecided check names its cause; held and failed name none. `note` carries a publisher's sentence (CH-5) or the harness's reason.

formal.$comment: Machine-checked's facts copied from properties/2 (RFC-0018 MC-1 to MC-6): the step the publisher's words reach before the proof build lowers it, and the scope card

petal.$comment: RFC-0018 §The glyph: one petal. `step` is the decided step, a word (GL-8); `state` is its ink, derived from the step; `cause` says why a petal is red or hollow; `basis` says whether the publisher's documents or our checks decided it; `lowered_by` names the checks that set it red (GL-2). The row's prefixItems fix each id.

allOf.$comment: state is the step's ink; a green or amber petal has no cause
GL-3: a hollow petal is not decided and names why
GL-2: a petal our check set red names the checks; no other petal names any
only Machine-checked carries `formal`; null when its properties file is not read
only Weights hidden carries `visible`; null when its properties file is not read

reading.$comment: N1: true when a fact the petal's decision read carries a note, so the value is the reader's reading, not the publisher's words; absent means false

sources_read.$comment: R-SILENT: on a red with cause not_stated, the documents read, each linked at the pin; absent otherwise

allOf.$comment: OR-1, OR-4: only a passed, ranked row holds a position

generation_multiple.$comment: CO-7: the generation part over the baseline's GPU-seconds per reply

glyph.$comment: GL-1 to GL-9: the five petals in drawing order; no field sums, counts or orders them (GL-8); never moves a position (GL-4)

incomplete_sessions.$comment: SE-3: a session that ended incomplete, with its exit code and cause (AGENTS.md rule 5); it enters no figure and no check except RUN

multiple.$comment: CO-5: mean steady m over the baseline's GPU-seconds per reply; null (not_applicable) when the row has no steady state

proving_multiple.$comment: CO-7: the proving part over the baseline's GPU-seconds per reply

replaced_sessions.$comment: SE-3a: a counted session whose verify ran with a GPU visible and whose proofs were not kept, replaced in its slot by a later session of the same pin; it enters no figure and no check

session_commit_and_proving_gpu_seconds_p.$comment: CO-7 (amended 2026-11-13): the session cost per reply less its generation part (commit, the prove call outside its generation phase and the seconds between the two calls), mean of the counted sessions, scope whole_wall; null when the system has no generation phase of its own

session_commit_and_proving_multiple.$comment: CO-7 (amended 2026-11-13): the commit and proving part over the baseline's GPU-seconds per reply

session_generation_gpu_seconds_per_reply.$comment: CO-7 (amended 2026-11-13): the generation phase's GPU-seconds over N, mean of the counted sessions, scope whole_wall; null when the system has no generation phase of its own

session_generation_multiple.$comment: CO-7 (amended 2026-11-13): the session's generation part over the baseline's GPU-seconds per reply

session_gpu_seconds_per_reply.$comment: CO-1: GPU-seconds from the start of commit to the release of the last proof, over N; mean of the counted sessions

session_multiple.$comment: CO-5: session cost per reply over the baseline's GPU-seconds per reply, printed as 'whole sessions of N replies'

generation_gpu_seconds_per_reply.$comment: CO-3: the generation phase's GPU-seconds (between the adapter's generation marks) over the session's N replies, included in m; null when the session has no generation phase

steady_generation_gpu_seconds_per_reply.$comment: CO-7: the generation phase's part of m, mean of the counted sessions; null when the system has no generation phase of its own or no steady state

steady_gpu_seconds_per_reply.$comment: CO-3: mean m of the counted sessions; null when any counted session has no steady state

steady_proving_gpu_seconds_per_reply.$comment: CO-7: m less its generation part, mean of the counted sessions; null as the generation part

teacher_forced.$comment: RFC-0018 SI-9: teacher-forced top-token agreement and KL (FI-10 to FI-15) from teacher-forced.json, printed beside fidelity; absent while not scored. No check, petal, position or order reads it

label.const: computed by the system's own code on the reference reply, not by the proved computation
computed by the system's own code on the reference reply, not by the proved computation

scope_cell.$comment: one cell of Machine-checked's scope card, copied from properties/2; printed as a recorded fact, it sets no state

visible_item.$comment: Weights hidden: one value a proof leaves visible, copied from properties/2; only fitted_to_weights sets a state (WH-5)

description: releases/<release>/board.json, written by `iproofs release board` from stored records only (RFC-0018 §The board file). Rungs in the level file's order; rows in the order rule's order (OR-5).

date.$comment: the newest run date among the records read; null when nothing has run

frontier.$comment: OR-6: the largest rung with a passed row; null when no row has passed

title: Level board (RFC-0018 §The board file)
